content:
A full capture converts an authorization hold into an equal posted debit. With no other event, releasing the hold and deducting the same amount leaves spendable principal unchanged.

A partial capture instead releases the unused portion. The authorization amount is not a guaranteed final charge. Refund eligibility depends on merchant advice; a genuine capture is not refundable merely because another record has the same merchant name.
